case_study_packaging.headline: Choice Health at Home unlocks $534K in annual savings in under 5 months through Treya-led strategic sourcing
case_study_packaging.client_problem_statement: Choice Health at Home had grown rapidly across seven states through acquisitions, but purchasing remained decentralized and largely unmanaged. Fragmented supplier relationships, inconsistent pricing, and limited spend visibility were eating into margins just as private-equity backers Trive Capital and Coltala Holdings were seeking EBITDA acceleration. With more than $17 million in indirect and clinical-support spend on the table, the leadership team needed an expert partner to capture quick, material savings and put a scalable procurement process in place before mid-year budget planning.
case_study_packaging.client_problem_anonymized: A rapidly expanding multi-state home health and hospice provider had grown through acquisitions, but purchasing remained decentralized and largely unmanaged. Fragmented supplier relationships, inconsistent pricing, and limited spend visibility were eating into margins just as the private equity ownership group was seeking EBITDA acceleration. With more than $17 million in indirect and clinical-support spend on the table, the leadership team needed an expert partner to capture quick, material savings and put a scalable procurement process in place before mid-year budget planning.
approach_summary: Analyzed $39 M in AP data and mapped $17.7 M of spend across 12 priority categories, identifying $0.54–1.2 M in realistic savings potential.
Ran a two-round competitive RFP for Medical Supplies, leveraging volume aggregation to secure a 20% price cut and execute a new two-year McKesson contract.
Restructured the client’s Enterprise fleet maintenance program, negotiating mileage-bucket pricing that reduces fees by up to 48% and delivers $140K in annual savings.
Benchmarked office-supply pricing through leading GPOs (OMNIA, Procure Analytics, GroupSource) to generate double-digit savings while maintaining uninterrupted branch supply.
Standardized rate cards and prepared negotiation playbooks for therapist and nurse staffing vendors, positioning the client to save 6% on nearly $1.6 M in temp labor spend.
case_study_packaging.value_delivered_blurb: Treya has secured $276K in hard-dollar savings already flowing through invoices and another $258K awaiting final signatures—totaling $534K in annual run-rate impact, or 2.1× the fixed project fee. The first savings went live just 150 days after kickoff, and the client now benefits from disciplined bidding processes, standardized fleet maintenance tiers, and quarterly KPI tracking that will sustain savings long term.
where_we_were_unique: Delivered first contract execution and realized savings within five months despite limited baseline data and decentralized stakeholders.
Deep healthcare-supply expertise enabled a 20% reduction on core medical SKUs while keeping the incumbent distributor—minimizing clinical disruption.
Hands-on data cleansing and supplier outreach compensated for the client’s lack of centralized procurement infrastructure.
Guaranteed 1.5× ROI on fees and ultimately delivered more than 2× value, exceeding stakeholder expectations.
